yt_title: Stop commenting GUIDE on reels. Do this instead
caption:
Stop commenting GUIDE on every reel you save.

22 of my 156 saved reels hid the steps behind a comment. SaveSort flags them as Gated guides, so you know which saves have the info and which ones are just after your comment.

Before you comment: check the caption, search the tool's name, see if it's free already.

Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded. Link in bio.
